exposure: QI initiative to reduce post-caesarean opioid use
postpartum order set maximising the use of scheduled NSAIDs and acetaminophen
non-opioid therapy as first-line, with opioids reserved for breakthrough pain
outcome: Total morphine milligram equivalents (MME) consumed during postpartum admission
Percentage of patients discharged with a prescription for opioids
cohort: Women over 18 years undergoing caesarean section at an academic hospital in the USA
finding: Implementation of a quality improvement initiative including nursing education and a postpartum order set maximizing the use of scheduled NSAIDs and acetaminophen significantly reduced opioid use after cesarean section while achieving comparable pain control.
